candidates.description: The specific drug combination used for adjuvant chemotherapy following surgical resection of the lung adenocarcinoma.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Identify the chemotherapy drugs administered after surgery in the 'History of Present Illness' or 'Assessment' sections.
candidates.measurement_definition: The combination of chemotherapy agents documented in the medical history or assessment; categories include Cisplatin/Pemetrexed (including Alimta) and Cisplatin/Vinorelbine.
candidates.name: adjuvant_chemotherapy_regimen
candidates.uncertainty: It is uncertain if some patients received other platinum-based combinations not explicitly listed in these excerpts.

citations.quote: Currently no radiographic or clinical evidence of disease. ECOG PS 0.

candidates.description: The Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status, which assesses the level of functioning of cancer patients.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Search for 'ECOG' or 'performance status' followed by a numeric value in the assessment or physical examination sections.
candidates.measurement_definition: The numeric ECOG PS score as explicitly stated in the clinical notes (e.g., 'ECOG PS 0', 'ECOG 1', 'ECOG PS 2').
candidates.name: ecog_performance_status
candidates.uncertainty: Performance status may fluctuate over time (e.g., from 2 to 1 as seen in one patient), making the 'baseline' timing for the modifier ambiguous.

limitations: Limited number of patients provided in the evidence chunks.
Molecular markers (e.g., EGFR, KRAS) are inconsistently documented across patients, preventing their use as reliable candidates.
summary: The provided evidence identifies baseline clinical variables in patients with resected stage II/III adenocarcinoma of the lung, specifically focusing on the choice of adjuvant chemotherapy regimen and functional status (ECOG PS) during the surveillance period.
